name: 아홉널 그로크
quote: 모든 파편이 모여, 완성된 재앙이 되리라.
body_structure: 수많은 작은 괴물들이 뭉쳐 거대한 구형에 가까운 형상을 이룬 형태
face: 수십 개의 눈이 무질서하게 박힌 일그러진 면면
eyes: 각기 다른 크기와 빛을 내뿜는 다수의 눈들
tail: 여러 마리의 꼬리가 엉킨 거대한 촉수 뭉치
skin: 짙은 보라색과 형광 연두색이 뒤섞인 유기적 질감
silhouette: 중심이 비대하게 큰 구체 형태, 사방으로 뻗어 나가는 날카로운 뼈 조각과 엉킨 꼬리 뭉치, 주변을 에워싼 작은 파편들의 후광
signature_motion: 화면 전체를 가로지르는 거대한 돌진 후 사방으로 파편을 폭발시키며 확장됨
signature_vfx: 형광 연두색의 중력파가 중심에서부터 원형으로 퍼져나가며 주변 적들을 빨아들임
unique_features: 수십 개의 눈이 박힌 거대한 구체 몸체
몸 주변을 공전하는 마력 파편 후광
visual_en: A massive, spherical body composed of fused dark purple and deep violet organic masses, featuring dozens of glowing eyes of various sizes. A bright neon green aura emanates from the central singularity core, surrounded by a halo of sharp, white bone fragments and floating magical shards. Multiple thick, intertwined tails made of dark violet tentacles lash out from the base. The entire entity is accented with vibrant magenta energy pulses. The silhouette is dominated by a heavy, central weight with chaotic, sharp elements orbiting the core, all facing right.
features_en: Massive spherical body with dozens of eyes
pose_en: A heavy, menacing stance, lunging forward with unstoppable momentum.
vfx_en: Expanding concentric rings of neon green gravity waves and magenta sparks.
motion_en: Massive forward charge followed by an omnidirectional burst
lore: 화면에 몹이 너무 많이 쌓이면 전부 뭉쳐서 생겨나는 융합 보스. 돌진과 사방 탄막을 쓰고, 닿으면 기절시키고, 밀리지 않는다.

anim_notes.skill: firing a barrage of glowing bullets outward
anim_notes.ultimate: slamming a glowing warning circle onto the ground and summoning minions
anim_notes.vfx: a glowing red warning circle on the ground
anim_notes.entrance: forming from many small monsters clumping together into one giant body

frame_notes.vfx: concentric glowing rings with eye-shaped patterns on the ground, abstract shapes only
frame_notes.entrance_1: It keeps exactly the same body as the reference: a huge purple brain-like head with glowing green spots and tentacles below. No human body, no cape, no cloak, no human legs or head
frame_notes.hit_0: Every part of the character and every effect ends well inside the picture, with empty background visible along all four edges. No grey or flat-edged shapes; the green light stays small and close to the body

body_plan.body: A purple, amorphous creature with a large, bulbous head containing glowing green eyes and a bright core, featuring two thick limbs and two large tentacles.
